entries.title: Account settings in a row's menu show whether they are on
entries.body: An account's menu in Subscriptions now lists its settings first, each with a switch: Prefer for crew work, Keep going on credits, Use saved resets on their own and Paused. Its one-time actions follow below a line. Picking a setting turns it on or off and leaves the menu open, so you see the switch move. A connection's menu in Integrations shows Paused the same way.

picture.alt: A Codex account's menu in Subscriptions with four settings at the top, Prefer for crew work and Keep going on credits switched on, and the actions below a line
